definitions.explanation: Causing trouble or difficulty. Not easy to use or access. The opposite of {便利|べんり} (convenient).

examples.japanese: この{場所|ばしょ}は{交通|こうつう}が{不便|ふべん}です。
{車|くるま}がないと{不便|ふべん}です。
{不便|ふべん}な{生活|せいかつ}に{慣|な}れました。
examples.english: I got used to the inconvenient lifestyle.

notes: Combines {不|ふ} (not) and {便|べん} (convenience). Direct opposite of {便利|べんり}. Often used to describe locations with poor access to transportation or services.
